attempts.outcome: Not met: MuMu dynamic_adjust_frame_rate held the display in its 15 Hz mode (VSYNC 66.7 ms), so averages were ~15 fps and event p95 ~130-140 ms. Diagnosis: SurfaceFlinger active mode 15 Hz, primaryRefreshRateRange [0 15]. Correction: dynamic_adjust_frame_rate=false through MuMuManager, player restarted (60 Hz, VSYNC 16.7 ms). Setting restored to true and the player restarted after S4.

Not met: p95, JS tasks, taps and rows passed, but the sheet sample counted the scripted 0.47 s idle wait between open and close as frame time (30.5 fps while every frame met its 16.7 ms vsync with 0 jank), and the later sheet/list JS samples were marked invalid by dropped counts 24-82. Diagnosis from React Native 0.86 source: droppedEntriesCount reports evictions from the process-wide 150-entry event buffer since process start, while observers receive every entry. Correction (s3j2.py): fresh app process before each part; sheet open and close measured as separate frame windows.
